name: Amamine Mika
source:
She's a Japanese student studying abroad at an Italian university.
She gets involved in a murder incident in Rome, is framed as the murderer, and arrested.
A good person at heart who doesn’t forgive bad deeds, she is reluctant to live on the run as a fugitive.
Having the power to read people's strong emotions and memories when she touches them with her hands from birth, she always wears gloves to avoid reading people's hearts inadvertently.

Hometown: Yokohama [Japan]
